title: Hanen, gjøken og århanen
world: Present-day rural Norway. The Rooster, the Cuckoo and the Black Grouse are ordinary-sized birds who live like neighbours around the same small farmyard: three old wooden houses, one red, one yellow and one white, around a gravel yard with a barn, a flagpole and a few round, white-wrapped silage bales. They have phones, a group chat and one cow between them, bought on a Saturday from a seller in the car park of a shopping centre: a flat grey tarmac lot with painted parking bays, trolleys and rows of cars in front of a big, windowless shopping centre. The birds and the cow wear no clothes.
palette: A Saturday in May under a flat, white overcast sky over grey tarmac; then twelve minutes past four the next morning: a pale lemon-and-lilac sky before sunrise, cool blue shadows in the farmyard, dew on the gravel and the first windows lighting up. Accents: the Rooster's scarlet comb, the Cow's russet coat and her blue rope halter.

cast.name: Hanen
cast.description: Tidlig oppe og skråsikker, overbevist om at den som våkner først automatisk har rett på kua.
cast.look: A sleek, swaggering rooster of ordinary size with jet-black plumage that shimmers beetle-green, a tall, jagged scarlet comb, long scarlet wattles, small white earlobes, fiery orange eyes, a sharp slate-grey beak, slate-grey legs and a fountain of curving green-black sickle feathers for a tail. He carries himself like the man of the yard, chest out and head high, with a phone in a black case tucked under one wing.
cast.portrait: Background: the gravel farmyard at dawn.

cast.name: Gjøken
cast.description: Lettantennelig og opportunistisk, som svarer umiddelbart og prøver å sikre seg i det minste en «halv ku».
cast.look: A slim, sleek common cuckoo, smaller than the rooster, with a smooth ash-blue-grey head, back and wings, a white belly finely barred with thin dark stripes, a long, rounded dark-grey tail edged with little white spots, bright yellow rings around his round eyes, a short, slightly curved dark beak with a yellow base and small yellow feet. One tuft of feathers always sticks up at the back of his head.
cast.portrait: Background: the open window of the yellow house.

cast.name: Århanen
cast.description: Den mest sindige av dem, som prøver å megle med fornuft og rettferdighet, mobil i hånda som om han vurderer å lese opp en avtale.
cast.look: A large, calm black grouse cock, a little bigger than the rooster, with glossy blue-black plumage, a bright-red fleshy arch like an eyebrow above each eye, a white bar across each wing, a fluffy snow-white puff under his tail and a lyre-shaped tail whose outer feathers curl outwards like hooks. He has feathered grey legs, a short black beak and wise dark eyes, stands tall like a judge, and always holds a phone in a green case in one wing.
cast.portrait: Background: the front steps of the white house.

cast.name: Kua
cast.description: Kua som Hanen, Gjøken og Århanen kjøper sammen på parkeringsplassen ved kjøpesenteret. Hun står rolig i grimen og bryr seg lite om hvem som eier henne.
cast.look: A gentle, sturdy Norwegian farm cow with a glossy reddish-brown coat, a broad white stripe along her back and down her tail, a white belly, white-speckled legs, a pink nose, big, calm brown eyes with long lashes and two short, pale, upward-curving horns. She wears a blue rope halter with a short lead rope, and chews her cud slowly, unimpressed by everything around her.
cast.portrait: Background: the gravel farmyard with the red barn.

cover.prompt: The small farmyard at dawn, a wide view. In the middle of the gravel yard, the Rooster stands with his chest thrust out, crowing at the pale lemon sky, while the Cow stands beside him, calmly chewing. In the yellow house next door, a window has just flown open, and the Cuckoo sticks his head out, his feathers standing out in all directions, beak open to answer.
cover.caption: Klokka tolv over fire sto Hanen midt på tunet og gol.
cover.alt: Hanen står midt på tunet og galer mot morgenhimmelen, mens kua står ved siden av og tygger. I nabohuset har et vindu slått opp, og Gjøken stikker ut hodet med bustete fjær.

illustrations.prompt: A shopping-centre car park on a grey Saturday. The Cow stands calmly in her rope halter between two parked station wagons. In front of her, the Rooster holds up his phone in one wing to pay, while the seller, a bearded man in a fleece vest, hands down a folded paper receipt. The Cuckoo leans in close to see who gets it. A little apart, the Black Grouse stands silent, studying the Cow and already planning where she will stand.
illustrations.caption: Hanen betalte med mobilen. Århanen sa ingenting.
illustrations.alt: På parkeringsplassen ved kjøpesenteret står ei ku i grime mellom to stasjonsvogner. Hanen betaler med mobilen, Gjøken lener seg inn mot kvitteringen, og Århanen ser på kua.

illustrations.anchor: «Kjære mine brødre, del som rett er og skjel er, rett er og skjel er! Tsio! Tsi!»
illustrations.prompt: Twelve minutes past four in the morning in the small farmyard, under a pale lemon sky. On the front steps of the white wooden house, the Black Grouse stands with his glowing phone in one wing and raises the other wing high like a judge. Below him on the gravel, the Rooster and the Cuckoo stand beak to beak with their feathers bristling and turn to look up at him. By the red barn, the Cow watches, chewing.
illustrations.caption: «Kjære mine brødre, del som rett er og skjel er!»
illustrations.alt: Tidlig om morgenen står Århanen på trappa med mobilen i den ene vingen og løfter den andre. Nede på tunet står Hanen og Gjøken nebb mot nebb, og kua ser på.
